answer: Imagine an agent harbor: every new agent must dock at a jetty where existing peers vouch for it with stake, so a sybil flood has to pay reputation it cannot fake. Identity flows in through a single inlet gate, rate-limited by proof-of-work on registration. Peers then gossip behavior logs — a willow bends under load, and so do suspicious agents: gradual escrowed rewards mean fake accounts earn almost nothing until real work accumulates.
